content: Readiness probe convention (k8s v1-33 docs + Tyk/Kong/Serverpod/actor-ts health-check docs): readiness endpoint 200 when fully ready to serve, 503 when not; readiness checks verify critical dependencies exist/connect and MUST NOT include data-freshness/age; liveness probe stays trivial always-200 and must not check dependencies. Matches HLT-02 letter: stat existence/readability only, staleness never 503s.
